implemented_capabilities.capability: Basis-aware verdict inheritance along a mutation DAG (conditional validity)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Pure, DB-free rule table: each debunk basis (fabricated, misattributed, wrong_figure, misdated, overstated, missing_context) survives only specific mutation types; a hop that breaks the basis returns 'broken' with the before/after delta; per-hop decay times edge confidence with threshold and max depth; multiple paths are combined and the strongest inherited path wins. Fails safe (unlisted mutation breaks the basis).

implemented_capabilities.capability: Skeptic confidence-lowering pass (can only keep or lower confidence)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Pure rules applying single-source and uncertain-direction penalties, contested-origin cautions and weak-link call-outs; lists fact-checks 'notCarried' with reasons.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Claim lineage graph with provenance on every edge, DAG/date guards
implemented_capabilities.notes: MERGE-based idempotent writes; MUTATED_FROM refuses self-links, cycles (loop query) and backwards-in-time parents; edges carry asserted_by, at, confidence, direction_certain, low_confidence_types; uniqueness constraints plus range and vector indexes.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Named Cypher queries Q1-Q6 incl. vector search, upward/downward traversal, WCC
implemented_capabilities.notes: Uses FalkorDB-native db.idx.vector.queryNodes + vecf32 + vec.cosineDistance and algo.WCC (not Neo4j GDS); all reads via GRAPH.RO_QUERY; verdict is recomputed at read time from the graph, nothing cached as truth.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Four-agent pipeline (Extractor, Linker, Skeptic, Writer) coordinating through the graph
implemented_capabilities.notes: Extractor and Linker are LLM prompts (same/mutation/related/unrelated judgments validated by zod, capped by MUTATION_RELIABILITY); agents persist AgentRun/Finding nodes and read each other's findings from the graph (shared memory). Skeptic agent wraps the pure rules. LLM budget, cache and backoff are real.
Custom SVG/CSS graph rendering of the story family; polls /api/analysis/[id] to show live agent trace read from the graph.

graph_models_and_cypher: Nodes: Claim{id,text,embedding vecf32,first_seen,attributed_to,synthetic}, Sighting, Publisher, Source, FactCheck{verdict,basis}, AgentRun, Finding. Edges: SIGHTING_OF, PUBLISHED_BY, MUTATED_FROM{types[],before_text,after_text,confidence,direction_certain,low_confidence_types,asserted_by,at}, ORIGINATES_FROM{established,confidence,evidence_url}, CHECKED_BY{verdict,basis}, FOUND, ABOUT. FalkorDB-native features: vector index (CREATE VECTOR INDEX ... OPTIONS {dimension, similarityFunction:'cosine'}), db.idx.vector.queryNodes, vec.cosineDistance, algo.WCC, UNIQUE constraints via constraintCreate, variable-length paths *0..N with depth interpolated as Math.trunc(int) constants. No APOC/GDS.
algorithms: Basis-compatibility path walk with per-hop confidence decay and threshold (domain/propagation.ts:evaluatePath)
Multi-path verdict merge: strongest inherited path wins, others kept (deriveVerdict)
Variable-length upward traversal to fact-checked ancestors with reduce() decay (queries.ts Q4)
Weakly connected components over MUTATED_FROM for story families (Q5, algo.WCC)
Cosine nearest-neighbour candidate retrieval with 0.75 similarity floor (Q1, linker.ts MIN_CANDIDATE_SIMILARITY)
Cycle and temporal-order guard on DAG insert (writes.ts:linkMutation)
backend_interfaces: Next.js route handlers: POST /api/analyze, GET /api/analysis/[id], GET /api/lineage/[claimId], GET /api/health
CLI (tsx): scripts/analyze.ts, query.ts (run named Q1-Q6), seed.ts, schema.ts, preflight.ts
frontend_interfaces: React 19 / Next.js: LineageApp, LineageGraph (556 lines), AnswerPanel, AgentTrace, AmbientTree, FlipNumber
agent_or_memory_mechanisms: Agents coordinate only through graph nodes (AgentRun -[:FOUND]-> Finding -[:ABOUT]-> Claim): later agents read earlier findings via readFindings(); per-run and per-day LLM budgets; LLM response cache keyed by hash(provider, model, prompt, schema). Mode 'recorded' serves presets without LLM calls.
tests_present: tests/propagation.test.ts (~15 cases), tests/skeptic.test.ts (~6), tests/writer.test.ts (~4); vitest, pure rule tests with no DB. No tests for Cypher queries, linker or API routes. Not executed by auditor.
dependency_requirements: docker image falkordb/falkordb:v4.22.0 (matches Kairos server version)
GEMINI_API_KEY (optional Groq key) only for free-text analysis
security_findings: src/graph/writes.ts:139 - label interpolated into Cypher (t:${o.targetLabel}); typed as the union 'Source'|'Publisher' so safe unless the type is bypassed.
src/graph/queries.ts:51,101,126 - variable-length depth bounds interpolated via Math.trunc(config...) (integers from env; safe).
src/graph/schema.ts:34,53 - DDL built from constant label/key maps (safe).

src/llm/llm.ts:36-40, src/llm/embed.ts:36 - outbound HTTPS to generativelanguage.googleapis.com and api.groq.com (llm.ts:74) with key in x-goog-api-key / Authorization header; fixed hosts, not user-controlled. User claim text (<=2000 chars) is sent to a third-party LLM (README privacy note).
src/app/api/analyze/route.ts - unauthenticated POST triggers paid LLM calls in 'local' mode; guarded by LINEAGE_MODE != local (403) and a single global 'running' lock; no per-user rate limit.
docker-compose.yml - FalkorDB exposed on host ports with no password (local default).
.env.example contains empty placeholders only; no committed secrets found. README references DECISIONS.md and AI_USAGE.md that are not present in the checkout.
duplicates_or_overlaps: Overlaps claim/fact-check lineage and misinformation provenance (Research & Legal Evidence), and at an abstract level 'does an upstream finding still apply downstream' dependency invalidation. Distinct from code blast-radius repos because validity depends on edge change type, not mere reachability.
evidence_drift_relevance: HIGH - propagation.ts is a conditional-validity engine: an upstream verdict (evidence) is carried down a derivation chain only while the change types on each hop keep its basis valid, otherwise it is explicitly 'broken' with the delta and demands its own check; verdicts are recomputed from the graph at read time and edges carry asserted_by/at/confidence provenance, though there is no versioning/supersession of the fact-checks themselves.

strongest_reusable_unit.why: A small, pure, unit-tested rule table mapping (basis of an upstream finding x kind of change on the hop) to survive/break/correction with decay and depth caps; generalizes to Kairos 'does this evidence still hold after the upstream thing changed' checks. Pair with Q4 (variable-length upward path query returning per-hop change types).
strongest_reusable_unit.external_runtime_needed: None for the rule module (pure TypeScript, ~280 lines, trivially re-implemented in Python); Q4 needs FalkorDB; LLM key only for the Linker agent

strategy_rationale: Re-implement propagation.ts (basis x change-type survival table, decay, multi-path merge) and the Q4 path query as a Python shared engine for evidence-validity checks; the claim-misinformation domain, Next.js UI and Gemini linker stay reference-only. Language mismatch (TypeScript) means port, not import; no LICENSE file so reuse relies on attested owner permission.
